Modularity & Scalability
* No limits on battery pack design
* Support for low and high voltage systems
* Compact design
Advanced technology
* CAN communication
* Telematics for remote monitoring
* Advanced SOC algorithms
* Supports all Li-Ion chemistry cells

* Plug'n'play system - easy to setup and install

Customization
* Integration with external devices
* Customization of operational logic
* Automotive grade components available

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

of visits at your business.

## Protecting lives through the Precise calibration of Advanced Driver-Assistance systems

At Car ADAS our mission is to protect lives through the precise calibration of vehicle safety
systems.

Help us make the world a safer place to drive – contact us to learn how you can open your own
calibration center today.

[ Own A Calibration Center ][36]

## Welcome To The Future Of Automotive Repair — ADAS Calibration

Our ADAS solution enables your shop to operate its own calibration center, so that you can yield the
numerous benefits that performing calibrations in-house provides. You’ll be able to cut out the
middle man and return the vehicle to the customer with its ADAS systems performing as intended while
generating significant financial returns.

Owning a calibration center requires minimal investment in time and money. We supply the ADAS
equipment and help our clients with setting up their facility, employee trainings, implementation,
quality control, and support.

[ Own A Calibration Center ][37]

### 12 Key Elements of Our ADAS Solution

Our ADAS calibration solution helps overcome some of the biggest challenges to entering the ADAS
services market.

ADAS is technology incorporated into a vehicle in order to automate, adapt, and enhance the driver’s
experience with features that increase safety.

When an ADAS feature is engaged, it may light up a symbol on the dashboard, alert the driver through
sound, or momentarily take control of the vehicle.

### [What is ADAS?][39]

### The Automotive Industry At A Glance

The automotive calibration and repair world is changing. As vehicles continue to become more
complex, so does repairing them!

In 2019, almost 60 million vehicles in the U.S. were equipped with some sort of ADAS technology,
like parking assistance, adaptive cruise control, or collision-avoidance systems.

By 2022, all new vehicles on the U.S. market will have at least one ADAS system — automatic
emergency braking. 

In order to return a damaged vehicle to OEM specifications, an understanding of ADAS is critical for
repair facilities. 

[adas calibration near me]

### [Popular ADAS Systems][40]
* [**Blind Spot Monitor**][41] – sensors in the rear bumper and displays warning icons in both side
  mirrors
* **[Automatic Emergency Braking][42] – **forward facing ADAS camera or radar detects crash risks
  and automatically applies the vehicle’s brakes
* **[Pedestrian Detection][43]** – detects an imminent collision with a pedestrian and autonomously
  applies the brakes or alerts the driver
* **[Adaptive Cruise Control][44]** – cruise control setting that will slow down and pace a vehicle
  with the one in front of it
* **[Traffic Sign Recognition][45] **– video cameras detect some types of road signs and display
  them on a dashboard
* **[Lane Departure Warning][46]** – provides drivers with an alert when they drift out of their
  lane unintentionally
* [**Lane Keeping Assist**][47] – provides steering assistance to keep drivers in their lane 

### [ADAS Sensors][48]

With more vehicle autonomy than ever, drivers are relying on powerful technology to stay safe. If
that technology isn’t repaired correctly, it could spell disaster. Driver assistance systems rely on
sensor data collected by camera, lidar, radar, and other sensors located throughout the vehicle. 

What happens when [ADAS sensors][49] are moved and replaced, during windshield replacement?
Likewise, what happens if there is a collision that jolts cameras and other sensors out of their
factory-specified position?

Recalibration is vital to ensure that automated warnings and vehicle actions are provided under the
right conditions. 

### [What is ADAS Calibration? ][50]

[ADAS calibration][51] (and recalibration) is the precise alignment of ADAS sensors following
several situations: windshield replacement, collisions, changes in suspension and vehicle alignment,
and adjacent repair services.

[ADAS calibration][51] (and recalibration) is the precise alignment of ADAS sensors following

Calibration needs are vehicle-specific and can include in-shop calibration, on-road calibration, or
both types of procedures. Calibration requires special equipment and training. Additionally,
in-shop, or static, calibrations, require very precise measurements, in a controlled environment. 

### Modern Collision Repair with ADAS Calibration

In the past, when a vehicle was involved in a front-end collision, a technician could simply repair
the structural damage and move on. Now, it’s not so simple. If that vehicle has radar in the front
bumper, it’s likely that the ADAS sensors were damaged and will need to be recalibrated for
functional safety. This changes the repair workflow!

### Body Shops Must Consider A New Workflow

ADAS sensors require repairers to alter their existing auto repair workflow to include both static
calibration and dynamic calibration procedures. 

Accuracy is the top priority. Historically, in the automotive industry, shorter cycle times have
been the measure of a successful, profitable shop. Not anymore. With ADAS, even small errors can
have dangerous implications.

## company strength

#### DALY BMS

To become a leading global provider of new energy solutions, DALY BMS specializes in the
manufacturing, distribution, design, research, and servicing of cutting-edge [Lithium Battery
Management Systems (BMS)][39]. With a presence spanning over 130 countries, including key markets
like India, Russia, Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Argentina, Spain, the US, Germany, South Korea, and
Japan, we cater to diverse energy needs worldwide.

 

As an innovative and rapidly expanding enterprise, Daly is committed to a research and development
ethos centered on “Pragmatism, Innovation, Efficiency.” Our relentless pursuit of pioneering BMS
solutions is underscored by a dedication to technological advancement. We have secured close to a
hundred patents, encompassing breakthroughs such as glue injection waterproofing and advanced
thermal conductivity control panels.

 

Count on DALY BMS for state-of-the-art solutions tailored to optimize the performance and longevity
of lithium batteries.

DISTRIBUTED. CENTRALIZED. CUSTOMIZED
* All Lithium chemistries support
* Single cell balancing current range 0.4A-6A

## Why EMUS BMS?

Modularity & Scalability
* No limits on battery pack design
* Support for low and high voltage systems
* Compact design
Advanced technology
* CAN communication
* Telematics for remote monitoring
* Advanced SOC algorithms
* Supports all Li-Ion chemistry cells
Simplicity in operation
* Plug'n'play system - easy to setup and install
* Wide range of customizable parameters for battery performance
* Dedicated support engineer during BMS installation
Customization
* Integration with external devices
* Customization of operational logic
* Automotive grade components available

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

# Custom computer vision for medical devices and applications

## RSIP Vision offers field-tested software solutions and custom R&D prowess to power your next
## product with innovative image analysis capabilities.

## [Read more about us][56]

### Trusted by industry-leading medical
### device companies

### We work in multiple fields

For over two decades, at the forefront of medical image analysis and AI, our technologies have
contributed to multiple medical systems and surgical procedures. We have been involved in joint
replacement surgery, bronchoscopies, cath labs, and so much more.

### Cardiology

### Cardiology

We executed successful cardiac image analysis projects in all the relevant imaging modalities-CT,
MRI, fluoro, ultrasound, point cloud-powering product development.

[ View ][57]

### Orthopedics

### Orthopedics

RSIP Vision brings specific field-tested experience in solving real-world orthopedic imaging
challenges for multiple clinical use cases.

[ View ][58]

### Gastro

### Gastro

From efficient disease screening to advanced endoscopy and interventional use cases, RSIP Vision’s
technologies are here to help you lead the pack in this fast-growing space.

[ View ][59]

### Pulmonology

### Pulmonology

Tumor classification, registration of X-ray images with pre-op CT scan, and segmentation of the
lungs’ components: our developments can do it all.

[ View ][60]

### Surgical

### Surgical

AI-assisted surgery is one of the most important emerging frontiers in medical imaging. We build the
technologies to improve the OR of the future.

[ View ][61]

### ENT

### ENT

Proven expertise and experience in ENT, including overcoming registration challenges, CT and MRI
image fusion, catheter navigation during procedures, and more.

[ View ][62]

### Urology

### Urology

Versatile experience and extensive clinical understanding of AI in the urology field. CT, MR,
fluoro, ultrasound, and video, we handle them all.

[ View ][63]

### Ophthalmology

### Ophthalmology

Proven expertise and experience in ophthalmology, including fundus image stitching, eye tracking,
OCT retinal layer segmentation, and many more.

[ View ][64]

### And multiple modalities

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

## EV Charging Questions, Answered

How do EV charging stations work?

Electric charging stations function by converting power from the electrical grid to direct current
that electric vehicles use. DC fast chargers, which allow quick charging in minutes using higher
voltages and wattages, are only available at public stations. 

Drivers plug their vehicles into the electric vehicle charging stations, which deliver power to the
vehicle's battery charging system. When done, drivers unplug so the next EV can charge up from the
ever-flowing grid power supply. Home stations wire directly into the home's electrical system.

[Answers to your questions when installing ev chargers.][18]

Are EV charging stations worth it?

Yes, due to all the long-term benefits. See below for the three primary reasons EV charging stations
are worthwhile.
1. **Preparing for the future:** As more people embrace electric vehicles, electric charging
   infrastructure will be necessary, and businesses that install stations will position themselves
   for future success. [EVs are here to stay][19].
2. **Reduced energy costs:** EVs are cheaper than gas vehicles, saving fleet operators money on
   fuel.
3. **Customer retention/attraction:** Having an electric charging station works to attract and
   retain customers, as EV drivers frequently visit places with convenient charging stations. 

Can owning an EV charging station be profitable?

Owning an EV charging station can be a profitable business opportunity as it has recurring revenue
streams. Offering an EV charging solution provides profit from charging fees. 

As the EV market continues expanding to [meet consumer demand and sustainability goals][20], more EV
drivers will need access to a commercial charging station, increasing the volume of fees an EV
charging station collects. Locating stations in busy areas like coffee shops, restaurants,
convenience stores, and malls is a great strategy to enhance an EV charging experience, [contribute
to sustainable transportation,][21] and make more profits.

Why should I consider installing an EV charging station?

One important reason to install an electric vehicle charging station is to demonstrate your
commitment to sustainability by supporting clean energy options. Then, as EV adoption increases,
you’ll be [ahead of the curve][22] by offering electric vehicle charging availability for customers.
You can generate income from fees, subscriptions, advertising, or premium parking by providing
charging. Any place with EV charging stations makes more profits as charging drives more foot
traffic and spending at shopping centers and parks.

What factors should I consider when choosing an EV charging station?

When choosing electric car charging stations, consider the following factors:
* Intended location
* Desired charging speeds
* Number of ports you’ll need
* Maximum power output 
* Payment options 
* Safety certifications
* Equipment warranties, service, and support

[Considerations for installing EV charging stations at your location.][23]

What types of EV charging stations do you offer?

At Blink, we offer electric vehicle charging station products for commercial and residential use. We
offer Level 2 charging stations and DC fast chargers for commercial properties. [Why should you
consider a Level 2 charging station?][24]

Our products provide Level 2 and DC fast charging capabilities in various form factors like
pedestals, wall mounts, and mobile units.

Is any maintenance required for EV charging stations?

Yes, maintenance is required for electric cars’ charging stations to ensure proper and safe
operation and reduce downtime. [Ways of maintaining EV charge stations][25] include cleaning
connectors or ports to remove debris. It’s also best to inspect ports for loose connections and
faults and perform software updates to optimize performance. 

What support services do you offer?

Blink provides 24/7 customer support through multiple channels to address any questions. We also
install new equipment, perform maintenance and repair, and perform remote monitoring to maintain
functionality. 

Additional services include over-the-air software updates and training resources for customers and
partners. Blink aims to offer a reliable EV charging experience with around-the-clock assistance.

Blink offers [turnkey EV charging services][26], including installation, maintenance, and support,
to keep your charging stations running smoothly for longer.

# Your ADAS Calibration Implementation Partner

## Protecting lives through the Precise calibration of Advanced Driver-Assistance systems

At Car ADAS our mission is to protect lives through the precise calibration of vehicle safety
systems.

Help us make the world a safer place to drive – contact us to learn how you can open your own
calibration center today.

[ Own A Calibration Center ][36]

## Welcome To The Future Of Automotive Repair — ADAS Calibration

Our ADAS solution enables your shop to operate its own calibration center, so that you can yield the
numerous benefits that performing calibrations in-house provides. You’ll be able to cut out the
middle man and return the vehicle to the customer with its ADAS systems performing as intended while
generating significant financial returns.

Owning a calibration center requires minimal investment in time and money. We supply the ADAS
equipment and help our clients with setting up their facility, employee trainings, implementation,
quality control, and support.

[ Own A Calibration Center ][37]

### 12 Key Elements of Our ADAS Solution

Our ADAS calibration solution helps overcome some of the biggest challenges to entering the ADAS
services market.

[ Own A Calibration Center ][38]
[calibration companies near me]

ADAS is technology incorporated into a vehicle in order to automate, adapt, and enhance the driver’s
experience with features that increase safety.

When an ADAS feature is engaged, it may light up a symbol on the dashboard, alert the driver through
sound, or momentarily take control of the vehicle.

### [What is ADAS?][39]

A

ystems

### The Automotive Industry At A Glance

The automotive calibration and repair world is changing. As vehicles continue to become more
complex, so does repairing them!

In 2019, almost 60 million vehicles in the U.S. were equipped with some sort of ADAS technology,
like parking assistance, adaptive cruise control, or collision-avoidance systems.

By 2022, all new vehicles on the U.S. market will have at least one ADAS system — automatic
emergency braking. 

In order to return a damaged vehicle to OEM specifications, an understanding of ADAS is critical for
repair facilities. 

[adas calibration near me]

### [Popular ADAS Systems][40]
* [**Blind Spot Monitor**][41] – sensors in the rear bumper and displays warning icons in both side
  mirrors
* **[Automatic Emergency Braking][42] – **forward facing ADAS camera or radar detects crash risks
  and automatically applies the vehicle’s brakes
* **[Pedestrian Detection][43]** – detects an imminent collision with a pedestrian and autonomously
  applies the brakes or alerts the driver
* **[Adaptive Cruise Control][44]** – cruise control setting that will slow down and pace a vehicle
  with the one in front of it
* **[Traffic Sign Recognition][45] **– video cameras detect some types of road signs and display
  them on a dashboard
* **[Lane Departure Warning][46]** – provides drivers with an alert when they drift out of their
  lane unintentionally
* [**Lane Keeping Assist**][47] – provides steering assistance to keep drivers in their lane 

### [ADAS Sensors][48]

With more vehicle autonomy than ever, drivers are relying on powerful technology to stay safe. If
that technology isn’t repaired correctly, it could spell disaster. Driver assistance systems rely on
sensor data collected by camera, lidar, radar, and other sensors located throughout the vehicle. 

What happens when [ADAS sensors][49] are moved and replaced, during windshield replacement?
Likewise, what happens if there is a collision that jolts cameras and other sensors out of their
factory-specified position?

Recalibration is vital to ensure that automated warnings and vehicle actions are provided under the
right conditions. 

### [What is ADAS Calibration? ][50]

[ADAS calibration][51] (and recalibration) is the precise alignment of ADAS sensors following
several situations: windshield replacement, collisions, changes in suspension and vehicle alignment,
and adjacent repair services.

Likewise, what happens if there is a collision that jolts cameras and other sensors out of their
factory-specified position?

Recalibration is vital to ensure that automated warnings and vehicle actions are provided under the
right conditions.

[ADAS calibration][51] (and recalibration) is the precise alignment of ADAS sensors following
several situations: windshield replacement, collisions, changes in suspension and vehicle alignment,
and adjacent repair services. 

Calibration needs are vehicle-specific and can include in-shop calibration, on-road calibration, or
both types of procedures. Calibration requires special equipment and training. Additionally,
in-shop, or static, calibrations, require very precise measurements, in a controlled environment. 

### Modern Collision Repair with ADAS Calibration

In the past, when a vehicle was involved in a front-end collision, a technician could simply repair
the structural damage and move on. Now, it’s not so simple. If that vehicle has radar in the front
bumper, it’s likely that the ADAS sensors were damaged and will need to be recalibrated for
functional safety. This changes the repair workflow!

### Body Shops Must Consider A New Workflow

ADAS sensors require repairers to alter their existing auto repair workflow to include both static
calibration and dynamic calibration procedures. 

Accuracy is the top priority. Historically, in the automotive industry, shorter cycle times have
been the measure of a successful, profitable shop. Not anymore. With ADAS, even small errors can
have dangerous implications.

## company strength

#### DALY BMS

To become a leading global provider of new energy solutions, DALY BMS specializes in the
manufacturing, distribution, design, research, and servicing of cutting-edge [Lithium Battery
Management Systems (BMS)][39]. With a presence spanning over 130 countries, including key markets
like India, Russia, Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Argentina, Spain, the US, Germany, South Korea, and
Japan, we cater to diverse energy needs worldwide.

 

As an innovative and rapidly expanding enterprise, Daly is committed to a research and development
ethos centered on “Pragmatism, Innovation, Efficiency.” Our relentless pursuit of pioneering BMS
solutions is underscored by a dedication to technological advancement. We have secured close to a
hundred patents, encompassing breakthroughs such as glue injection waterproofing and advanced
thermal conductivity control panels.

 

Count on DALY BMS for state-of-the-art solutions tailored to optimize the performance and longevity
of lithium batteries.

# Advanced machinery telematics

[Advanced machinery telematics by Technoton]

We offer comprehensive solutions for remote monitoring of road and off-road trucks, locomotives, sea
and river vessels, diesel generators (gensets), fuel storages and tanks, technological machines.
Major parameters monitored are: [fuel consumption][56], time and engine operation mode, volume and
temperature of fuel, operation of attached equipment, axle load.

**[Documentation][57]**

**[Software][58]**

**[Training][59]**

**[ODM services][60]**

**[Documentation][61]**

**[Software][62]**

**[Training][63]**

**[ODM services][64]**

Technoton [telematics solutions][65] allow machinery owners and operators to dramatically improve
efficiency of operation and decrease costs.

Our expertise:
* Fuel consumption monitoring of diesel engines
* Monitoring of stationary and movable/mobile fuel tanks
* Contactless reading, analysis and conversion of data from CAN j1939 and j1708 buses
* Data integration of standard CAN j1939 and j1708 buses into telematics and GPS monitoring systems
* Integration of standard analog sensors into telematics systems
* Monitoring of 10800+ technological parameters 24/7 in real-time

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

Technoton’s products are designed using technologies employing edge/fog computing methods, which
ensure accurate parameter measurement, scalability of a telematics system, reliable operation and
guaranteed compatibility of the equipment.

Since 2000, Technoton has been developing, manufacturing, and supplying fuel monitoring and
telematics solutions for remote asset visibility and analytics.

Technoton smart sensors and turnkey hardware kits are used in trucks and commercial vehicles,
trains, construction, agri- and mining machinery, marine and river vessels, power generators,
stationary fuel tanks, industrial fuel systems.

Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

## THE LONDON EV COMPANY

### LEVC: A Legacy of Innovation and Sustainable Mobility Solutions

Since 1908, LEVC (London EV Company) has been at the forefront of British automotive craftsmanship
and innovation. Renowned for designing the first dedicated black cab for London, our brand has
become a symbol of quality, reliability, and timeless design.

In 2018, we revolutionized urban mobility with the launch of the electric TX—the world's cleanest
and most advanced taxi with groundbreaking eCity, REEV (Range-Extended Electric Vehicle) technology.
This pioneering model reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation and sustainability, helping
cities around the globe transition to greener transport solutions.

As we continue to build on our iconic heritage, LEVC is transforming into a high-volume,
all-electric automotive leader. With a forward-thinking strategy, we are dedicated to creating
smarter, cleaner, safer, and more accessible mobility solutions designed for modern living.

Our mission is to redefine the future of urban transportation—driving progress while reducing
environmental impact. Join us in setting new standards in efficiency, innovation, and excellence.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.
